title: Recovery of the final string
statement: For any bit strings $x,U,t,a,j,p$, let $\langle r,s\rangle$ denote the encoding formed by doubling each bit of $r$, appending the separator $01$, and then appending $s$. The total second projection, which returns the second component of a parsed pair and the empty string when parsing fails, applied three times to $\langle\langle x,U\rangle,\langle\langle t,a\rangle,\langle j,p\rangle\rangle$ returns $p$.
